sources.snippet: Fun-ASR-MLT-Nano-2512 is the 800M-parameter multilingual checkpoint in the Fun-ASR family. It is trained on hundreds of thousands of hours of multilingual speech and supports 31 languages, with emphasis on East and Southeast Asian languages.
